summary: This standard covers companies that purchase, inventory and sell pharmaceutical products and medical equipment to hospitals, pharmacies and physicians. Disclosure topics include fleet fuel management, product safety, counterfeit drugs, product lifecycle and packaging, and business ethics.

questions.text: What is your payload fuel economy?
questions.hint: Unit: Litres/RTK · Report fuel use in litres per revenue tonne-kilometre (RTK) for your distribution fleet and state the period covered.

questions.text: What efforts does your organisation make to reduce the environmental impact of logistics?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe measures such as fleet efficiency, route optimisation, alternative fuels and modal shift, and any results achieved.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with product safety?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: What efforts do you make to minimise the health and safety risks of products sold associated with toxicity/chemical safety, high abuse potential or delivery?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how you manage each of the three risk areas: toxicity or chemical safety, abuse potential, and delivery.

questions.text: What methods and technologies do you use to maintain traceability of products throughout the distribution chain and prevent counterfeiting?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the tracking, serialisation or authentication systems and partner controls used.

questions.text: What is your due diligence process to qualify suppliers of drug products and medical equipment and devices?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the checks, audits, licensing verification and ongoing monitoring applied to suppliers.

questions.text: What is your process for alerting customers and business partners to potential or known risks associated with counterfeit products?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how risks are identified, who is notified, through which channels and how quickly.

questions.text: What strategies do you use to reduce the environmental impact of packaging throughout its lifecycle?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe measures such as material reduction, recycled content, reuse and recyclability, across the lifecycle.

questions.text: What amount, by weight, of products accepted for take-back was reused, recycled or donated?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report the weight in metric tonnes of products accepted for take-back that were reused, recycled or donated.

questions.text: What efforts do you make to minimise conflicts of interest and unethical business practices?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the policies, training, monitoring and reporting channels in place.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses from legal proceedings associated with bribery, corruption or other unethical business practices?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total amount in your presentation currency, covering monetary losses from legal proceedings (fines, settlements, judgments) in the reporting period; state the period and currency.

questions.text: How many pharmaceutical units did you sell, by product category?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of units sold for each pharmaceutical product category.

questions.text: How many medical devices did you sell, by product category?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of devices sold for each product category.
